name: QoderWake
desc: Always-on digital employees that own recurring work
desc_zh: 常驻在线、长期负责一项工作的数字员工
solves: Recurring duties stall whenever the owner is offline; a Waker keeps identity, memory and skills and resumes on its own.
solves_zh: 固定职责只要负责人不在线就停摆，数字员工带着记忆和技能自己接着干。
best_for: A job needs a standing role for alerts, follow-ups or reports rather than a one-off chat.
best_for_zh: 告警、跟进或周报这类事需要有人一直盯着，而不是临时聊一次。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://changelog.qoder.com/llms.txt, https://blog.qoder.com/llms.txt）。 Backfill: released before the window and absent from the ledger.
